reels.caption:
The Ultimate Secret: Burying a Luxury Bus for a Hidden Underground Suite! 🏛️💖
Turning a decommissioned long-distance bus into a luxury underground masterpiece. We've taken "hidden architecture" to a whole new level by burying this giant deep beneath the surface using our signature pink foam technology.

From the massive excavation and precise placement to the stunning interior reveal, witness the engineering behind one of the world's most unique secret retreats. A perfect blend of surreal design and functional living.

Would you live in a hidden bus bunker? Let us know your thoughts in the comments! 👇✨

Global Audience & Content Distribution: United States | Canada | United Kingdom | Australia | Germany | Norway | Netherlands | Switzerland

reels.caption:
For this project, our client envisioned a villa with the calm, immersive atmosphere of a resort.
⠀
That vision shaped every design decision, including the elongated pool. Rather than functioning only as a place for swimming, water becomes a central part of the architecture,bringing reflections, natural light, freshness, and a sense of calm into the courtyard.
⠀
While this particular view highlights the relationship between water and the surrounding spaces, circulation and access are carefully resolved within the villa's overall layout.
⠀
The pool's placement is an intentional response to the atmosphere and experience our client wanted to create.
⠀
At Sevenora, we translate each client's dream, lifestyle, and vision into a meaningful architectural experience.
